{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", trial_df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id']).sum())
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
print(trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe())

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the resulting DataFrame
print("\nAfter deduplication:")
print(trial_df.shape)
print(trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())"}
